gizmo.title: Kaalaandarii
gizmo.description: Taateewwan faayilii kaalaandarii keessa jiran akka kaardii guyyaa, sarara yeroo, gabatee ykn tarreetti agarsiisi.

configure.title: Faayilii kaalaandarii
configure.description: Faayilii kaalaandarii .ics ol fe'i ykn filadhu. Taateewwan isaa barbaacha keessatti dubbifamu.

configure.title: Akkasitti agarsiisi
configure.description: Waan faayilii keessa jiru akkamitti akka dhiyaatu.

configure.title: Mata duree
configure.description: Taateewwan olitti, akkasumas akka ibsa gabateetti agarsiifama. Durtiin isaa maqaa kaalaandarichaa ti.
